chunks: From him, from Ali ibn Asbat, from his father Asbat ibn Salim, from Musa al-Ibar, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), that he said:
Be wary of the Arabs, for they have a bad omen/portent. Indeed, not one of them will rise with the Qaim.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Arabs in relation to the Qaim according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Kitab al-Ghayba*, Imam al-Sadiq (a.s.) warns of the 'bad news' or negative historical trajectory associated with the Arabs, a reference often interpreted by Shia scholars as their political dominance and subsequent deviation from the Ahl al-Bayt. He clarifies that while they may hold power, none of them will be among the true companions who rise with Imam al-Mahdi (a.s.) to establish justice, distinguishing their temporal rule from the spiritual legitimacy of the Qaim.
